cause: BF DMA base changes did not disable the previous model texture-offset table.
correction: Clear texture_offset, texture_shift, and texture_count in the BF handler, matching the original RSP microcode enable-byte reset.

matched_replay.note: Some bad image shifts are subsequently undone by the existing LoadBlock heuristic; image-shift counts are not counts of visibly corrupted frames.

original_game_reference.visual_observation: Original game shows rock-textured asteroids in the corresponding opening sequence.
original_game_reference.comparison_limit: Appearance check, not pixel-aligned full-scene parity.

regression.behavior: Real installed command handlers clear used and unused tables at BF and allow later explicit table rearming.

scope_limits: New-game opening cinematic and command-level reset semantics; not full-campaign renderer equivalence.
